summary: Wii U-specific game entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: Nintendo Land
entries.definitive_edition: Original Wii U version on hardware with GamePad and required controllers

emulation.emulator: Cemu only for limited preservation testing
emulation.notes: Original Wii U hardware is strongly preferred because GamePad asymmetry is core to the game.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Original Wii U hardware with GamePad and Wii Remotes

primary.version: Physical or already-owned digital Wii U version
primary.why: Nintendo Land is built around Wii U GamePad asymmetry and local multiplayer hardware, so original Wii U hardware is the fidelity route. Wii U eShop purchasing has ended, making physical or already-owned digital copies the practical official paths.
primary.how_to_play: Use Wii U hardware with the GamePad and required Wii Remotes/Nunchuks for multiplayer attractions. Record disc/digital state, region, controllers, player count, attractions played, GamePad condition, and whether eShop access limitations affected the run.

all_releases.fidelity: Original Wii U launch/pack-in route using Wii U GamePad asymmetry.
Official digital route for users who already own it.
all_releases.reason: secondary: new Wii U eShop purchases are closed, but existing downloads may remain usable.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Completeness depends on Wii U GamePad, Wii Remote/Nunchuk availability, player count, and local hardware condition.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record player count and controller setup; do not substitute generic emulation for GamePad/local-multiplayer behavior.
